title: MARCO-BOLO csv-to-json-ld: a CSV-W to JSON-LD pipeline for marine biodiversity metadata
description:
DRAFT RELEASE — WORK IN PROGRESS. THIS IS NOT A FINISHED PROJECT. This archive is a snapshot of active, unfinished development work, deposited for citability and transparency only. The CSV schemas, the JSON-LD output format, the vocabulary mappings and the contents of the accompanying data CSVs are all subject to change without notice, and the outputs should not be treated as a stable or authoritative MARCO-BOLO metadata product. Breaking changes between this and any subsequent release are expected.

csv-to-json-ld is the tooling MARCO-BOLO Work Package 1 uses to turn human-editable CSV files describing project entities (datasets, people, organizations, places, instruments, platforms, taxa, workflows, licenses and related resources) into validated, schema.org-aligned JSON-LD. Metadata is authored in a set of per-class CSVs, described with CSV on the Web (CSV-W) metadata documents, checked against CSV-W constraints, manual foreign-key constraints and SHACL shapes, and then converted to RDF and framed as JSON-LD for publication and harvesting. A persistent identifier scheme (MARCO-BOLO permanent identifiers, or mPIDs) links records across classes.

The pipeline is driven by make and runs inside Docker, so it can be executed locally or in CI. In MARCO-BOLO it runs on a schedule: partner-contributed metadata is synchronized from a shared spreadsheet, validated, converted, and the resulting JSON-LD is published for discovery through international research infrastructures, beginning with ODIS.

This repository is developed under MARCO-BOLO (MARine COastal BiOdiversity Long-term Observations), Horizon Europe grant agreement No. 101082021.
